notes: Seed https://www.dentoncounty.gov/; the elections site www.votedenton.gov returned an empty HTTP 202 (bot protection), so county-page links could not be read and were not worked around. Denton's Clarity elections.json lists all three elections, and the check 1 script read every update. In each election an early-vote update stamped before 7 PM already had per-precinct numbers; election-night updates then added election-day votes in several steps.
tag_rationale: All three elections are LIVE (check 1: precinct numbers in 5 to 7 election-night Clarity updates each), so the tag is LIVE_PRECINCT with high confidence.

2024_general.fact: Clarity update log for TX/Denton/122426 '2024 General Election': an early-vote update stamped 11/5/2024 6:47:29 PM CST already has precinct votes in 226 precincts (27611 nonzero cells); 7 election-night updates from 8:57:31 PM CST to 11/6/2024 1:12:14 AM CST all have precinct votes, with nonzero precinct vote cells rising 28978, 31585, 33853, 37121, 38553, 38553, 38579.

2026_primary.fact: Clarity update logs: '2026 Republican Primary' (126053) has 6 election-night updates 9:24:08 PM CST to 3/4/2026 12:43:48 AM CST with precinct votes in 235-236 precincts, nonzero cells rising 53961 to 73578; '2026 Democratic Primary' (126054) has 7 election-night updates 9:23:14 PM to 1:26:36 AM CST, cells rising 36706 to 52210.

2026_runoff.fact: Clarity update logs: '2026 Republican Primary Runoff' (126377) has 5 election-night updates 8:44:31 PM CDT to 10:44:44 PM CDT with precinct votes in 232-234 precincts, nonzero cells rising 4857 to 6589; '2026 Democratic Primary Runoff' (126378) has 5 updates 8:46:04 PM to 10:47:03 PM CDT, cells 1650 to 2385.
